query: INSERT INTO vaults (vault_id, kind, owner, head_seq, head_hash, rver, epoch, state, dissolve, created) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (vault_id) DO UPDATE SET kind = excluded.kind, owner = excluded.owner, head_seq = excluded.head_seq, head_hash = excluded.head_hash, rver = excluded.rver, epoch = excluded.epoch, state = excluded.state, dissolve = excluded.dissolve, created = excluded.created
